task: Task 3 - discovering and proving the exact ColorOS gesture hook point

hook_point.class_loader_evidence: SystemUI APK class (app classloader), runs in process com.android.systemui pid 1091 thread 1609 (gesture UI handler). NOT a bootclasspath class. Superclass stub Lcom/android/systemui/navigationbar/SideGestureDetectorEx; is also inside SystemUI.apk classes.dex (not framework).
upstream_entry_chain: InputMonitor named "edge-swipe" created by com.android.systemui.navigationbar.gestural.EdgeBackGestureHandler (classes.dex) for display 0 (see EdgeBackGestureHandler$$ExternalSyntheticLambda2 case 3)
onInputEvent$1: if isGestureUpMode() -> OplusNavigationBarGestureUp.onMotionEvent (ColorOS up-gesture nav variant); else -> SideGestureDetector.onMotionEventImpl(MotionEvent)  <-- side-back path

SideGestureDetector created by NavigationBarGestureEx.createSideGestureDetector(...) inside EdgeBackGestureHandler (~line 573); EdgeBackGestureHandler holds it as SideGestureDetectorEx field mSideGestureDetector

allow_gate_semantics.structure: AOSP isWithinTouchRegion(MotionEvent) single allow method is ABSENT (0 class/method hits in the whole APK). Region+allow decision is INLINE in the monolithic onMotionEventImpl(MotionEvent)V. All gate logs below are emitted from this one method.
action_down_region_logic: reset mAllowGesture=false, clear velocity, setBatchingEnabled(false), log 'Start gesture:'
left edge test x <= getSideGestureAreaWidthLeft() -> mIsOnLeftEdge
bottom strip test: if y >= displaySize.y - 50px (hot-zone avoid) or y >= displaySize.y - getBottomGestureAreaHeight() (66px on device) -> 'bottomGestureAreaHeight = ...' path (NOT side back)
status bar test: y <= mStatusBarHeight -> excluded
side region test using getSideGestureAreaWidthLeft/Right + smart-sidebar scene region (mSideBarSceneRegion / mSmartBarRegion) exclusion
allow_gate_semantics.allow_decision: Allow = f(mDisabledForQuickstep false, mIsBackGestureAllowed true, sysUiFlags allow-bit set, touch region valid). Rejections logged as 'AllowGesture false cuz: ' + StringJoiner('|') reasons: 'disabled for quickstep' | 'back Gesture not allowed' | 'back gesture disabled by sysui flags' | 'touch region not valid'.
allow_gate_semantics.dispatch: When mAllowGesture && shouldRespondToGesture() -> dispatchToBackAnimation(motionEvent) (SideGestureDetector.java ~line 1638; method signature (Landroid/view/MotionEvent;)V PUBLIC FINAL). If not allowed -> mis-touch inject bookkeeping and return; NO back dispatch.
allow_gate_semantics.downstream_final_back: dispatchToBackAnimation drives com.android.wm.shell.back.BackAnimation (classes2.dex inside SystemUI.apk; runs in pid 1091). Final Back dispatch = inner BackCallback SideGestureDetector$3.triggerBack (~line 240): if mBackAnimation != null -> BackAnimation.setTriggerBack(true) (log 'BackAnimation Triggered back'); else inject KEYCODE_BACK DOWN/UP via m9028$$Nest$msendEvent.

hook_point.practical_hook_implication: The only method that must be intercepted to gate side Back is a before/around hook on SideGestureDetector.onMotionEventImpl((Landroid/view/MotionEvent;)V) in the SystemUI process. IMPORTANT scoping caveat: this method also receives bottom-strip events (used for nav-handle animation) and rejects them internally; a blanket veto of onMotionEventImpl would also kill the bottom handle animation. The hook must veto ONLY regular touchscreen (source TOUCHSCREEN, toolType finger) ACTION_DOWN that lies in the left/right side-edge region and is NOT in the bottom home area - i.e. reproduce the allow-gate conditions and return false before the original method so mAllowGesture stays false and dispatchToBackAnimation / final Back never runs. Bottom Home/Recents itself is NOT performed by this method or process (see bottom_path_separation).
hook_point.verified_against_aosp: Conceptual mapping only: AOSP EdgeBackGestureHandler (android-16) is present as an AOSP fork in classes.dex and is the InputMonitor/region owner, but the allow decision was replaced by the oplus inline gate in onMotionEventImpl. AOSP class names were NOT used as proof; all behavior proven from this artifact.
